visits.chief_complaint: Worsening breathlessness on mild exertion, chronic productive cough
visits.diagnosis: COPD — moderate exacerbation. T2DM poorly controlled.
visits.doctor_notes: SpO2 93% at rest is concerning. FEV1 54% predicted — moderate COPD. HbA1c poorly controlled. Steroid course for exacerbation will worsen glucose control — monitor closely. Pulmonology referral.

visits.diagnosis: Acute COPD exacerbation secondary to bacterial infection. Hyperglycaemia secondary to infection and steroids.
visits.doctor_notes: SpO2 dropped to 88%. Type 2 respiratory failure developing — PaCO2 rising to 52. BiPAP initiated. Lung function deteriorating rapidly. This is the second severe exacerbation in 18 months. Weight loss of 1.5kg noted. Long-term oxygen therapy to be discussed.

visits.chief_complaint: Routine pulmonology follow-up, persistent dyspnoea at rest
visits.diagnosis: COPD — severe stage. Cor pulmonale suspected. T2DM moderately controlled.
medications: Metformin 500mg BD (reduced due to hypoxia risk)

lab_results.Echo: RV dilatation. Pulmonary artery pressure 42mmHg — mild pulmonary hypertension

visits.doctor_notes: FEV1 now 36% — severe COPD. Echo confirms early cor pulmonale with pulmonary hypertension. SpO2 90% at rest on room air — LTOT started. Weight loss continuing (4kg over 3 years). Metformin dose reduced due to hypoxia-associated lactic acidosis risk. Prognosis guarded.

visits.chief_complaint: Emergency admission — severe breathlessness, confusion, cyanosis
visits.diagnosis: Hypercapnic respiratory failure. Severe COPD exacerbation. Hyperglycaemia. Decompensated cor pulmonale.
visits.doctor_notes: Critical admission. PaCO2 72 with pH 7.22 — severe hypercapnic respiratory failure. Intubated and mechanically ventilated. The 4-year pattern of deteriorating FEV1, rising PaCO2, weight loss, and recurrent exacerbations was prognostically significant. NT-proBNP 2840 — severe cor pulmonale decompensation. ICU care. Family counselled on prognosis.
